sections.section_title: GPIOs controlled by the RTC and TAMP
sections.text_helper: Section 39.3.3 "GPIOs controlled by the RTC and TAMP" in chapter 39 (Real-time clock (RTC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1554.
sections.section_content:
RTC_OUT1, RTC_TS and TAMP_IN1 are mapped on the same pin. The RTC and TAMP
functions mapped on this pin are available in all power modes. This pin output mechanism
follows the priority order shown in Table393.
[Table 393. RTC pin configuration(1)]
In addition, it is possible to output RTC_OUT2 on PB2 pin thanks to OUT2EN bit. The
different functions are mapped on RTC_OUT1 or on RTC_OUT2 depending on OSEL, COE
and OUT2EN configuration, as shown in Table394: RTC_OUT mapping.
[Table 394. RTC_OUT mapping]
